finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: If argv[1] is crafted to include shell metacharacters or control operators, it could lead to command injection.
finding.assumptions: The code does not explicitly call any shell or command interpreter, but the use of fprintf with untrusted input could potentially be exploited if the file path or other parts of the code are vulnerable.
